lines: I remember being lost from the flock. You brought me back to the fold.
My thoughts were all tangled wool. You helped card them straight.
You helped pull me back when even my name felt far away.
Your face feels familiar, soft in one place and snagged in another.
I remember shivering, then warmth returning one thread at a time.
The memory is rough around the edges, but your face stayed in it.
I remember you through panic and wool-dark dreams. Keep your voice low.
I know you helped. I also remember why my hands still shake.
The cure left echoes behind. Stand where I can breathe around them.
I have seen broken wool with better instincts than you.
